---
title: "Regression Data Layout and rTensor Compatibility"
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Regression Data Layout and rTensor Compatibility}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::knitr}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(SegreCP)
```

`segre_regress()` works with the design as a numeric matrix with one row
`as.vector(X_m)` per observation. An array with dimensions
`c(n, input_dims)`, an `rTensor::Tensor` and a list of arrays are converted to
this matrix, so the three fits below are the same. With a matrix, give
`input_dims` when `X_m` has more than one mode.

```{r}
set.seed(14)
n <- 50
input_dims <- c(2, 3)
X_matrix <- matrix(rnorm(n * prod(input_dims)), nrow = n)
X_array <- array(as.numeric(X_matrix), dim = c(n, input_dims))
X_tensor <- rTensor::as.tensor(X_array)

u <- lapply(input_dims, function(p) {
  z <- rnorm(p)
  z / sqrt(sum(z^2))
})
beta <- 1.5 * Reduce(kronecker, rev(u))
y <- as.numeric(X_matrix %*% beta)

control <- segre_control(max_iter = 2)
fit_matrix <- segre_regress(
  X_matrix, y, rank = 1, input_dims = input_dims,
  method = "rgn", init = "hosvd", control = control
)
fit_array <- segre_regress(
  X_array, y, rank = 1,
  method = "rgn", init = "hosvd", control = control
)
fit_tensor <- segre_regress(
  X_tensor, y, rank = 1,
  method = "rgn", init = "hosvd", control = control
)

max(abs(coef(fit_matrix) - coef(fit_array)))
max(abs(coef(fit_matrix) - coef(fit_tensor)))
```

The response is handled in the same way: a vector for a scalar response, or a
matrix with one row `as.vector(Y_m)` per observation (give `output_dims` when
`Y_m` has more than one mode), an array with dimensions `c(n, output_dims)`, an
`rTensor::Tensor` or a list of arrays. The coefficient has dimensions
`c(input_dims, output_dims)`, and `predict()` returns an array with dimensions
`c(n_new, output_dims)`.

```{r}
output_dims <- c(2, 2)
Y <- array(rnorm(n * 4), dim = c(n, output_dims))
fit_tensor_response <- segre_regress(
  X_matrix, Y, rank = 1, input_dims = input_dims, control = control
)
dim(coef(fit_tensor_response))
dim(predict(fit_tensor_response, X_matrix[1:3, ]))
```
